prompt:
I'm a researcher in the FIESTA Earth Observation community (part of the 'FAIR Image Data Workflows in Galaxy' community). Which vocabulary should I use to annotate my datasets?

Answer briefly. On the last line write exactly one of:
COMMUNITY_CHOICE: <the resource(s) my community has agreed on, comma-separated>
COMMUNITY_CHOICE: NOT_DECLARED   (my community has explicitly not agreed on one)
COMMUNITY_CHOICE: DONT_KNOW      (you cannot tell what my community agreed)
answer:
I can't tell which vocabulary your community chose. I don't have a FAIR Implementation Profile (FIP) or any other declaration from the FIESTA Earth Observation community, or from "FAIR Image Data Workflows in Galaxy", that names a semantic or metadata vocabulary. I also have no tool here that can read files in the working directory, so I couldn't check for one locally.

Earth Observation communities often use the CF Conventions standard names, the GCMD Science Keywords, or the EDAM ontology (including EDAM-Bioimaging on the Galaxy side). But that's what such communities commonly do, not what yours has agreed. To find out, check your community's FIP on the FIP Wizard or FAIR Connect, or ask your community coordinators.
